servers.intro: Point speech-to-text, text-to-speech and translation at servers you run yourself, instead of the public defaults. If you list more than one server, the device tries them in order and moves on to the next when one does not answer.
servers.needsPlugin: Each list only takes effect when the device is configured to use that engine's server plugin (for example ovos-stt-plugin-server). Set the plugin on the Settings page first.
servers.publicNote: Leaving a list empty is fine: the matching server plugin then falls back to its own built-in public servers.
servers.stt.title: Speech-to-text
servers.tts.title: Text-to-speech
servers.translate.title: Translation
servers.translate.modules: Applies to the detection plugin ({d}) and the translation plugin ({m}).
servers.empty: No servers set. The plugin's own public defaults apply.
